title: cold-standby: automate snapshot rotation and warm-standby promotion for on-prem/private installs
author: Aisha Patel
description: Introduce cold-standby automation and snapshot lifecycle management for private/VPC installs. Motivation: customers running Redwood Private in multi-AZ and air-gapped environments asked for a tested, repeatable mechanism to rotate backups, keep a warm/cold standby cluster ready for promotion, and validate restoreability as part of routine drills. This PR adds: 1) terraform/modules/backup_rotation: a new Terraform module that provisions cross-AZ snapshot replication rules (supports S3-compatible endpoints and MinIO), lifecycle policies (retention/rotation), and IAM templates for read-only failover roles; 2) helm/redwood/templates/init-restore-check.yaml: an optional Helm hook/initContainer that runs a lightweight restore verification using a small sample snapshot during node startup to surface silent backup drift in air-gapped installs; 3) terraform/ha/cold_standby.tf: orchestration resources to spin up a cold-standby cluster with pinned node pools and minimal services plus an admission webhook to prevent accidental promotion; 4) playbooks/dr/runbooks-as-code/cold-standby-promote.md: runbook-as-code for promotion, re-IPing, DNS cutover, and safety rollback steps (dry-run flags included); 5) tests/terraform: integration test harness for local MinIO emulation and automated restore validation in CI. Compatibility notes: module supports provider-agnostic S3 endpoints and the KMS integration uses existing customer KMS provider interface; no breaking API changes. Migration notes: operators must run terraform apply for new module and enable the helm restore-check hook in values.yaml if they want periodic self-checks. Checklist: - [x] Terraform module implemented and documented - [x] Helm hook added and optional by default - [x] Playbook written and verified in staging - [x] CI integration tests added - [x] Ops verification performed in private staging. See linked Linear items for rollout plan and followups.
commits: 3 commits: 1) add terraform backup_rotation module and docs, 2) add helm initContainer+hook and chart values, 3) add runbook-as-code and test harness; all commits signed and DCO-checked
review_conversation: Marcus Huang (reviewer): Can we avoid scheduling the restore-check at node startup by default? A: Author: Moved to optional helm hook off by default and added values.yaml toggle.

Diego Ramos (reviewer): Terraform module looks good but please ensure lifecycle rule TTL is configurable and documented. A: Author: Added 'retention_days' variable with default 30 and updated README with examples for 7/30/90 day policies.

Emily Chen (reviewer): The admission webhook needs a whitelist for automated promotions from CI/CD tooling. A: Author: Added 'promoter_service_accounts' list with example and tests to validate RBAC binding.

CI bot: ci/terraform-plan failed on first run due to missing variable default for minio_endpoint. A: Author: Added sensible defaults and improved error messaging in module variables.tf, reran plan and it passed.

Marcus Huang: Please add an operational note about cold-standby cost visibility in Console dashboards. A: Author: Added docs/ha/cold-standby.md with cost-accounting guidance and Grafana dashboard link.
release_notes: Added cold-standby automation for private installs: snapshot lifecycle module (S3/MinIO), optional Helm restore-check hook, runbook-as-code for promotion and rollback, and CI restore validation. Operators must enable module and optionally enable the Helm hook.
